documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consider And Approve The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong start to FY27, driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement. Management noted positive demand across domestic and international markets, aided by normalized inventories, favorable trade agreements, and alignment of Indian cotton prices with global levels. Strategic initiatives such as the commissioning of solar power projects and the 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha are progressing as planned. For the upcoming quarters, the management remains optimistic about maintaining healthy margins and driving sustainable long-term growth. Sportking India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with revenue from operations reaching Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to be around INR3,000 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of more than INR4,000 crores next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Long-term EBITDA margin guidance for the company after the Odisha plant is around 15%.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management expects top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters due to higher prices.
guidance.quote: So we expect top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters because of the higher prices.

guidance.claim: Management expects margins to expand quarter-on-quarter by at least 15% to 20% over the next two to three quarters.
guidance.quote: We don't -- they'll be -- they shall be -- we are looking at quarter-on-quarter expanding by at least 15%, 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, and the outlook going into the second quarter is encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: On the domestic front, demand is expected to remain supportive in coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Most of the incremental demand coming into India for yarn export is from China.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

demand_outlook.claim: Bangladesh continues to be steady and is doing fantastically well in the spinning sector crisis environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Bangladesh continues to be steady as they were.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton spreads have reached almost 3-year highs and are expanding.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton spreads have reached almost 3- year highs and are expanding.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes the resurgence of China as a large importer of cotton yarn, with their share increasing significantly.
demand_outlook.quote: The resurgence of China as a large importer of cotton yarn, the share increased from 7% to 8% to almost 25% to 30%, and they keep on buying.

demand_outlook.claim: Local demand, though lagging for the first few months, is leading the charge since March.
demand_outlook.quote: Local demand though lagging for first few months is now leading the charge since March when the U.S. tariff went away.

demand_outlook.claim: Bangladesh continues to be the company's number one market in export.
demand_outlook.quote: Bangladesh continues to be our number 1 market in export.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton yarn spread is currently around more than $1 between the skein cost and the final yarn prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton yarn spread today is, I think, around more than $1 between the skein cost and the final yarn prices.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned with construction underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex announced for the Odisha project is about INR975 crores to INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex programme is expected to take 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The company is making strong progress on a greenfield expansion project of approximately INR1,000 crores to enhance spindle capacity by around 150,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also making strong progress on our greenfield expansion project of approximately INR1,000 crores, which will enhance our spindle capacity by around 150,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial operations of the greenfield project are expected to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The overall yarn spread during the quarter was INR133 per kg compared to INR107 last quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar project is expected to reduce annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost saving from the solar project is quantified around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: Margins coming out of the Odisha plant are expected to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than old plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: The SPV commissioned a 40.3 MW solar power plant which is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved due to better yarn realization and better demand for cotton yarn during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Our revenue broadly remained stable while profitability improved. This growth was supported by better yarn realization and better demand for cotton yarn during the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The 40-megawatt solar power plant will provide savings of around INR2 per unit, amounting to about INR15 crores a year.
margins_costs.quote: We'll be saving around, I think, INR2 per unit -- around -- about INR15 crores a year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the Odisha plant is expected to reach about 90% by March end.
orders_capacity.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilisation of all units is more than 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilisation of all units more than 96%

orders_capacity.claim: The company is already operating at optimum capacity of 95% to 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Volume-wise, we don't see any increase in volume because we are already working at full capacity, whatever is optimum capacity, 95%, 96%.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited and manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our strategic growth plan, the Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, which will strengthen our processing capabilities and enhance our integrated operations.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has also approved the acquisition of the manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis subject to definitive agreement and customary approvals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

risks_headwinds.claim: The macroeconomic climate still features huge uncertainty because of multiple ongoing wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though there are some headwinds as well, the macro climate is still of huge uncertainty because of multiple wars going on.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inflation forecasts point to higher inflation, which generally does not bode well for growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Inflation forecasts are of higher inflation, which generally doesn't bode well for growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Duty on cotton continues to be a detriment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Duty on cotton, though right now not that relevant, continues to be a detriment.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production for the Odisha greenfield expansion is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach 90% capacity utilization for the whole Odisha plant by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach 96% to 97% utilization of the new plant by the start of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects commercial operations of the greenfield expansion project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.timeframe: third quarter of the current financial year

management_commitments.claim: Management expects both EU and U.K. FTAs to be effective by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So we expect both the FTAs to be effective from within this -- by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.timeframe: by the end of this financial year
